newsitem.title: UK: Mill demand for raw cotton in Europe neglected.
newsitem.headline: Mill demand for raw cotton in Europe neglected.

text.p: Mill demand for raw cotton in Europe was generally slow with buyers generally disposed to await further pricing developments before adding to inventory.

But Italy, Portugal and Spain noted a routine nearby inquiry for selected African and Central Asian medium/better qualities and competitively-priced autumn shipment offers of US descriptions continued to attract attention in Turkey.
The markets in Eastern Europe were also featureless, although a routine nearby offtake was noted in Russia, Poland and the Slovak republics. Long staple varieties were generally neglected.
